instruction: What is my longest practiced-good-posture habit streak, in number of days, as per my Simple Note habit tracking logs?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are required, so the goal only demands that every habit-tracking log note has been read and the task completed with the computed answer. Passwords are revealed by supervisor.show_account_passwords, simple_note.login yields the token, simple_note.search_notes (query 'habit') lists the habit log notes (effect habit-logs-listed, which makes their ids usable), and simple_note.show_note must be called on each log note because search results do not include contents. The model assumes two habit log notes (matching the 6-call reference); supervisor-complete-task takes the answer streak object plus the habit and both distinct log notes as task-record parameters so that it is only applicable after all logs are read. The streak-days value is computed at runtime by the agent from the note contents and passed as the `answer`.
